calculation.description: Ranks 20-session trend return by short-term realized volatility, with a bounded bonus for volatility compression relative to the 60-session baseline. Inputs are lagged through the prior completed session; negative validated orientation is retained for ensemble direction control.

validation.method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC against 10-session forward close return; date retained when at least 8 of 15 assets valid.
validation.regime_notes: Negative overall orientation is strong enough for admission under absolute IC/ICIR gates, but results are regime-dependent: 2025 -0.162375, 2027-2028 +0.013822, 2029 -0.065079, 2030 YTD -0.132459. Use direction -1 and conservative weight; recent evidence favors the reversal orientation.

signal_provenance.signal_definition: sig computed from close-only panel with no future data; forward target is P.shift(-10)/P-1 and is used only for validation
